scope: Synthetic algorithmic unit baseline only; prescribed Bernoulli response models, no subjects, sessions, biological measurements or clinical claims. Parent NEURO-001 empirical question remains OPEN.
domain: x in [-1,1]; all probabilities rational in [1/4,3/4]
selection: Maximize single-response mutual information under equal A/B prior. Compute H((pA+pB)/2)-(H(pA)+H(pB))/2 in bits; smallest x for ties within1e-14. No realized evaluation responses used.
evaluation: Each design repeats one stimulus8times with independent Bernoulli responses. Exact binomial count probabilities for k=0..8; rational candidate likelihoods and posterior; MAP ties score1/2, no random tie break. Fresh simulated responses after selection; the selected x necessarily appears in evaluation, so this is response holdout, not stimulus-domain or subject holdout.
metrics: posterior mean and probability max posterior>=0.95 under each truth including out-of-family C
per-seed Monte Carlo recovery/proportion comparison to exact distribution
simulation: 60 configurations=2designs*3truths*10seeds. 1000sequences/configuration,8draws/sequence =480000draws total. Seeds 10000+100*design_index+10*truth_index+seed_index with indexes0-based. Python random.Random and random()<float(p). Save binomial-count histograms (9counts/configuration), sufficient statistics for every metric, rather than individual responses.
acceptance: All rational binomial masses sum exactly1; likelihood/posterior normalized; entropy quantities agree with independent reviewer within1e-12.
Ordinary-domain candidate predictions identical; exact recovery1/2 and EIG0. Identical-model negative control must also give0EIG and1/2recovery for every grid point.
Directional positive-control hypothesis: diagnostic exact equal-prior recovery exceeds ordinary by>=0.1. Record FAIL without retuning if false.
MC pooled estimates differ from exact targets by<=0.025 for each truth/design; descriptive numerical consistency only, not a biological significance test.
Invalid-input, probability, and tampered-result controls must reject. No output implies closed-set confidence is calibrated under C.
stop: Stop on integrity failure, failed controls or30min. Preserve all attempted outputs. No adaptive threshold/model/grid changes.
limits: No fitted models, model flexibility, ecological validity, real subjects, public empirical data, cross-subject replication, mechanistic exclusion, novelty or parent-question completion. This affine choice replaces an earlier unfrozen sigmoid sketch before admission; no model computation preceded this freeze.
